extracted.intended_audience: OCS renewable energy lessees, grant holders, industry stakeholders, and their legal/technical advisors (participants in BOEM rulemaking/notice-and-comment)
extracted.subtask_description: Section-by-section explanation of BOEM's proposed amendments to 30 CFR Part 585 governing offshore renewable energy leases, grants, payments, financial assurance, plans, and related procedures. Intended to guide commenters and regulated parties on substantive and technical changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civil penalties for immediate threats
rubrics_metrics.description: Add a regulatory provision to allow BOEM to assess immediate civil penalties for violations that constitute or constituted a threat of serious, irreparable, or immediate harm or damage to life, property, mineral deposits, or the marine, coastal, or human environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Modeled after BSEE OCS oil, gas, and sulfur regulations; BOEM proposes new paragraph (f)(2) to cover situations where notice and opportunity to correct are not required and to permit appropriate action by assessing civil penalties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation of operator — conforming technical edits
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical edits to §585.405 to maintain consistency with reorganization of related sections (§§585.626 and 585.645).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Edits are organizational/technical and intended to preserve substance while aligning cross-references and section organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment application contents (use of BOEM forms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Eliminate specific regulatory elements for an assignment application that are already provided in BOEM forms (Form BOEM-0003 for leases, Form BOEM-0002 for grants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: BOEM will retain a paper copy requirement for assignment applications despite removing redundant regulatory detail; streamlines regulation by relying on form content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retention of paper copy requirement for assignments
rubrics_metrics.description: Continue requiring a paper copy for assignment applications even as some regulatory elements are removed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Paper copy requirement is explicitly retained in contrast to other regulations where paper copies are being eliminated.

rubrics_metrics.name: When an assignment results in a segregated lease
rubrics_metrics.description: Add §585.410 to explain when an assignment will result in a segregated lease and adopt language from 30 CFR 556.702 related to lease segregation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies process for segregating leases to accommodate phased development; provides legal and procedural basis for approvals under §585.408(a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment effects on assignor liability (renumbering)
rubrics_metrics.description: Re-number existing section to reflect addition of the new segregation section; maintains existing liability rules for assignors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Change is organizational (renumbering) rather than substantive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment effects on assignee liability (corrected citation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Correct extent of assignee regulatory liability by replacing 'subchapter' with 'part' in paragraph (b) of the assignee-liability section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical correction to align statutory/regulatory citations with intended scope of liability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidation of adjacent leases or grants — procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Codify procedures for requesting and approving consolidation of two or more adjacent leases or grants; harmonize differing lease/grant terms when consolidated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defaults: if remaining lease periods differ, the new lease defaults to the shorter remaining period (lessee may request extension per §585.235(b)); if other terms differ, default to the most recently issued terms and conditions; lessee may request modifications for good cause which BOEM will consider case-by-case; BOEM will assess need to modify financial assurances and may terminate fully consolidated leases/grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lease or grant suspension — terminology and application contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Change 'term' to 'period' in suspension provisions and reorganize suspension-application contents for clarity; add a catch-all category to provide BOEM flexibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adds new paragraph (b) to conform with §585.235(b); changes are procedural and editorial to clarify application requirements and add flexibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ordering suspension — eliminate paper copy requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Eliminate the paper copy requirement for BOEM-ordered suspensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aligns with proposed change to §585.110 removing paper-copy mandates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of suspension on payments — BOEM discretion
rubrics_metrics.description: Consolidate payment provisions and make fee suspension discretionary rather than mandatory with a directed suspension; clarify BOEM may 'waive or defer' (rather than 'suspend') payments while the lease or grant is suspended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives BOEM more flexibility to treat payments (fee/rent/operating fees) during suspensions depending on circumstances; directed suspensions would not automatically carry fee suspensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lease or grant renewal wording changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Change 'term' to 'period' across renewal provisions to align with §585.235 changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical/conforming change that does not alter substantive renewal rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria for renewal — catch-all provision
rubrics_metrics.description: Add a catch-all provision to the list of criteria BOEM will consider when deciding whether to renew a lease or grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permits BOEM discretion to consider relevant factors not specifically enumerated, recognizing unforeseeable future issues when renewal requests are filed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lease or grant termination wording change
rubrics_metrics.description: Change 'term' to 'period' in termination provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical/conforming change only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relinquishment effective date and process
rubrics_metrics.description: Make relinquishment effective on the date BOEM receives a properly completed relinquishment form (no BOEM approval required).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conforms with 30 CFR 556.1101 approach for mineral leases; relinquishment does not affect accrued obligations prior to relinquishment; ONRR will bill outstanding obligations after BOEM receives the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reissuance/reoffer of relinquished/cancelled areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow BOEM to restart competitive leasing for areas relinquished, contracted, or cancelled and to perform additional environmental analysis/consultation if necessary; allow reoffering to the next-best bidder if relinquished/cancelled within 6 months of auction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: BOEM may reoffer to next-best bidder within 6 months when that bid may still constitute fair return under 43 U.S.C. 1337(p)(2)(A).

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment due dates — bonus balance timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Change the due date for the bonus balance payment on a competitively issued lease from 'lease issuance' to 'within 10-business days of receiving the unsigned lease' (and update section reference).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides lessees more time to make required payments and clarifies timing language across payment rules; also replace 'issuance' with 'execution' where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terminology consistency — 'term' to 'period'
rubrics_metrics.description: Substitute 'period' for 'term' throughout payment and other sections to ensure consistent nomenclature with §585.235.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conforming terminology change across multiple sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: ROW/RUE rent valuation — annual rent per acre
rubrics_metrics.description: Replace annual ROW rent of $70 per mile with an annual rent of $5 per acre as determined by proposed §585.301(a) to ensure consistency in OCS valuation across RUEs and ROWs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale: consistency and streamlined rental calculations; BOEM determined no compelling reason for prior differential between RUE and ROW rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bid deposit requirements — BOEM discretion
rubrics_metrics.description: Eliminate provisions specifying deposits by auction type and give BOEM discretion to establish bid deposit requirements in the FSN.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures consistency with proposed §585.220 and allows BOEM to set deposit rules administratively.

rubrics_metrics.name: First 12 months' rent due date for commercial leases
rubrics_metrics.description: Require winning bidder to pay first 12 months' rent no later than 45-calendar days after receiving a copy of the executed lease from BOEM (instead of after sending unsigned copies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives lessees slightly more time compared to current regulation; also incorporates technical corrections to conform to 'commercial operations' definition and ONRR payment procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operating fees triggered by 'commercial operations' not testing
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify that operating fees are triggered at the start of commercial operations as defined in §585.112, and exempt electricity generated solely for testing purposes from operating fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: BOEM typically does not regard testing-period generation as commercial operations; final project verification under §585.708(a)(5) relevant to determination; also update payee to ONRR and define 'DOE' where necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: ROW/RUE corridor width and relinquishment
rubrics_metrics.description: Simplify ROW rental payments by providing initially wider ROW corridors that encompass planned seabed disturbance; grant holders can relinquish unused portions after construction and be relieved of rent thereafter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoids narrow 200-foot corridor/affected area determinations and better captures areas of actual disturbance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to defer, reduce, or waive payments
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicitly authorize BOEM to grant requests for deferral of rental and operating fee payments, in addition to reductions or waivers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies existing discretionary authority and reduces confusion about BOEM's ability to manage payments by deferral.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial lease initial financial assurance — 12 months' rent
rubrics_metrics.description: Replace the existing $100,000 lease-specific bond required before BOEM will execute a commercial lease or approve an assignment with a bond or other authorized financial assurance in the amount of 12 months' rent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale: ties bond to rent so BOEM/taxpayers are not under-bonded when annual rent exceeds $100,000; eliminates need for periodic CPI adjustments tied to a flat minimum bond; leads to removal/reservation of §585.515.

rubrics_metrics.name: SAP decommissioning bond timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Require the SAP decommissioning bond to be due before installation of SAP facilities rather than at the time of SAP approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes that liability for SAP facilities accrues at installation; aligns timing of financial assurance with accrual of liability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elimination of COP approval financial assurance requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Remove the bond or other financial assurance presently due before COP approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explained in section V.G.3(a); intended to avoid redundant up-front bonding where liabilities do not yet accrue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incremental/staged funding of decommissioning financial assurance
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow lessees to propose—and BOEM to approve or disapprove—incremental funding schedules for decommissioning financial assurance (fund during operations period or by facilities installed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed paragraph language permits staged funding subject to BOEM approval and risk analysis; intended to provide more flexibility compared with current rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terminology: 'supplemental financial assurance'
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopt the term 'supplemental financial assurance' to describe all financial assurance required after the initial assurance is provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simplifies terminology and eliminates redundant language about increasing the minimum base bond; cross-references other sections (e.g., §585.517).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of supplemental financial assurance for rent
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify that the obligation to maintain supplemental financial assurance for 12 months of rent applies only to the extent the rent is not covered in the initial financial assurance under §585.516(a)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures BOEM does not require duplicate bonding for the same rent obligation; streamlines paragraphs (a) and (b) and removes duplicative provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial financial assurance for limited leases, ROWs, and RUEs — 12 months' rent
rubrics_metrics.description: Replace fixed $300,000 initial financial assurance with an amount equal to 12 months' rent before BOEM will execute the limited lease, ROW, or RUE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Justification: rental obligations are the only liability at that stage and 12 months' rent will often be less than $300,000, reducing cost burden while ensuring coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjustment of limited lease/grant financial assurance as activities progress
rubrics_metrics.description: BOEM may increase or decrease a limited lessee's or grant holder's financial assurance depending on estimated costs of accrued obligations; amount must be no less than required to meet obligations; notice and opportunity to object required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lessee/grant holder may request reduction if assurance exceeds accrued obligations; BOEM has sole discretion to approve; substitute 'supplemental financial assurance' for 'decommissioning bond'; allow incremental funding; require annual reevaluation and timing tied to project NPV and actual operating efficiency and PPA pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance of alternative financial assurance instruments (including L/Cs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicitly authorize BOEM to approve non-enumerated financial assurance instruments, including letters of credit, subject to specified conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conditions for letters of credit include a minimum credit rating, a minimum term of 1 year, automatic renewal absent notice of cancellation to BOEM, and a venue provision requiring adjudication in U.S. district court; remove prior requirement that cash financial assurance be deposited and maintained in U.S. Treasury by BOEM.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party guaranty liability capping
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow BOEM to permit third-party guarantors to cap liability on guaranties provided to meet financial assurance obligations and permit guaranties 'in an amount determined by BOEM.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guarantor must either take corrective action or provide, within 7-calendar days (or agreed time), sufficient funds up to the value of the guaranty to remedy a violation; guarantor need only satisfy legal and financial aspects (§§585.106 and 585.107) and need not be technically qualified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lease-/grant-specific decommissioning accounts and staged funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow lessee or grant holder to fund a decommissioning account in stages over the lease or grant term according to a BOEM-determined funding schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed paragraph requires the account be funded in amount determined by and according to BOEM-approved schedule; funding schedule subject to BOEM approval and potential modification after risk analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surety/financial assurance termination notice period
rubrics_metrics.description: Require surety (financial assurance provider) to submit its request to terminate the period of liability to BOEM—and notify the lessee—no less than 90 days before the proposed termination date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Substitute 'financial assurance' for 'bond'; remove certain clauses; clarify that surety remains responsible for obligations accrued during the period of liability; lessee must provide replacement financial assurance only if it intends to continue activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation of financial assurance — timing and circumstances
rubrics_metrics.description: Revise cancellation rules to: (1) allow cancellation 7 years after termination of period of liability if replacement provider does not assume liabilities, (2) allow cancellation upon completion of appeals/judicial litigation addressing the obligation, and (3) otherwise clarify timing for cancellation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Substitute 'financial assurance' for 'bond' and 'cancel' for 'release'; streamline redundancy with §585.534; clarifies that cancellation may be delayed if litigation or appeals are pending.

rubrics_metrics.name: When BOEM may cancel financial assurance (general rules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Collapse distinctions among types of financial assurance and apply same regulatory cancellation requirements; financial assurance will not be canceled until 7 years after all operations and activities under the lease or grant cease (including decommissioning/site clearance) or longer if necessary to complete appeals; permit earlier cancellation when assurance no longer needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remove 'period of liability' column in chart as redundant; allow BOEM to require reinstatement of a cancelled financial assurance if an obligor's payment is rescinded due to insolvency/bankruptcy or materially false representations were made leading to cancellation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forfeiture of financial assurance — terminology update
rubrics_metrics.description: Update §585.535 to substitute the phrase 'financial assurance' for 'bond' in any forfeiture explanations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical/terminology change to maintain consistency across subpart.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revenue sharing terminology corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical corrections to remove redundant use of the word 'nautical' given the definition of 'miles' in §585.112 for revenue-sharing calculations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Minor editorial edits to §585.541 and §585.542.

rubrics_metrics.name: SAP requirement limited to engineered foundations
rubrics_metrics.description: Require SAPs only for site assessment activities involving an 'engineered foundation' (defined to include met towers or other structures installed using a fixed-bottom foundation requiring professional engineering design and sediment/meteorological/oceanographic assessment).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exempts floating site assessment facilities (e.g., met buoys using gravity anchors) from the SAP requirement; BOEM invites comment on the definition of 'engineered foundation' and recommends early consultation if applicant uncertain whether SAP required.

rubrics_metrics.name: BOEM discretion to waive plan information/analysis requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow BOEM to waive certain information or analysis requirements in a proposed plan when the applicant demonstrates that the information is known to BOEM, the relevant resource is not present/affected, or the information is not needed/required by a State's coastal management program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provision modeled on 30 CFR 550.201(c) to permit tailoring of plan requirements to unique proposals without issuing regulatory departures under §585.103.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing for submission of SAPs — removal of 12-month rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Remove existing requirement that SAPs be submitted either before or within 12 months after lease/grant issuance to provide lessees/grant holders flexibility (e.g., COP may be filed before SAP or SAP unnecessary for met buoys).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale: SAPs have usually been for met buoys and removal gives flexibility where site-assessment methods occur after COP filing or are unnecessary.
